context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 28 verified the catalog link feature. When bot finds products, it includes a link like /catalog?q=tazas in its response. The link is built from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + /catalog?q= + URL-encoded search term (with stopwords filtered). External/invented URLs are stripped. If AI doesn't include the link, it's appended as fallback. When no products found, bot asks for email (NEVER says 'no tenemos'). Staff receives SOLICITUD DE CATALOGO POR EMAIL alert when email collected. The /catalog page is public (no auth) and shows products with images and copy code buttons. IMPORTANT: GPT-5.2 has connection errors - use gpt-4o for testing by changing line 311 in bot_service.py.
